metadata.description: Red tiles form a branching tree-of-life motif inspired by Ukrainian embroidery. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Offset garden courts surround the motif, with staggered terraces along the lower route. 4 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 8 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
